author: everestmcarthur
description: Wormhole — an advanced cross-server/cross-channel communication relay with named networks, moderation, staff roles, message sync (edits/deletes/replies/reactions), per-network customisation, logging, statistics, filters, rate-limiting, and much more.
install_msg: Thanks for installing **Wormhole**!  Run `[p]wh help` to get started.
short: Advanced cross-server relay with networks, moderation & full sync
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores user IDs, guild IDs, channel IDs, and message-mapping data required for relay functionality. No message content is stored persistently.
